title: 2026 UK ETS SAF 65% versus 40% threshold option QA

sources.title: UK ETS treatment of SAF consultation - accessible webpage
UK ETS: Treatment of sustainable aviation fuel

facts.source_fact: Current UK ETS eligible SAF generally needs at least 65% lifecycle GHG savings.
The current threshold is linked to the RTFO sustainability criteria.
Older production plants can have a 55% threshold under the current framework.
The SAF Mandate uses a 40% minimum lifecycle GHG-saving threshold.
The Authority is consulting on maintaining 65% or aligning to 40%.
Maintaining 65% would preserve alignment with the EU ETS threshold described in the consultation.
Maintaining 65% could leave some SAF supplied under the SAF Mandate ineligible for UK ETS claims.
A 40% option is intended to support a wider diversity of SAF feedstocks and technologies.
The Authority expects claim-volume differences between the options to be relatively limited, with more material effects only in the medium term.
The 40% threshold is a consultation option, not an implemented UK ETS threshold.
